title: Residual-Guided Lightweight Reinforcement Learning for Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection with a Frozen World Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.22998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In automated driving, world models provide future scene predictions for evaluating candidate trajectories, but fixed selection rules may not capture scene-dependent trade-offs. We propose a residual-guided reinforcement learning (RL) framework for lightweight trajectory selection with a frozen world model and a fixed candidate bank. The framework uses proximal policy optimization (PPO) to fine-tune a joint policy over candidate selection and bounded trajectory residuals. A context-conditioned ranking network learns candidate preferences from feedback obtained by evaluating local perturbations of the selected trajectories. At inference, the selector combines learned preference and predicted risk ranks using fixed weights and returns the selected candidate trajectory without modification. translated_title: 基于冻结世界模型的残差引导轻量级强化学习风险感知轨迹选择
translated_abstract: 在自动驾驶中，世界模型为评估候选轨迹提供未来场景预测，但固定的选择规则可能无法捕捉依赖于场景的权衡。我们提出了一种残差引导的强化学习（RL）框架，用于在冻结世界模型和固定候选库的基础上进行轻量级轨迹选择。该框架使用近端策略优化（PPO）来微调覆盖候选选择和有界轨迹残差的联合策略。一个上下文条件排序网络通过评估所选轨迹的局部扰动所获得的反馈来学习候选偏好。在推理阶段，选择器使用固定权重结合学习到的偏好排名和预测的风险排名，并返回所选的候选轨迹而不进行修改。微调仅更新actor和critic中总共16,106个参数，而部署的选择器仅保留11,725个参数的排序网络……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于冻结世界模型的残差引导轻量级强化学习框架，仅需微调约1.6万参数即可实现自动驾驶中风险感知的高效轨迹选择。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a residual-guided lightweight reinforcement learning framework with a frozen world model, enabling risk-aware trajectory selection in automated driving by fine-tuning only about 16K parameters.
